dallas_sync.title: Dallas Sync
dallas_sync.description: Complete motel management, in production since September 2026 and sold on subscription to other motels. Front desk, inventory, finance and BI in one system.

captions.offline: Check-in, tabs and the cash register keep working when the internet drops. When it's back, everything syncs on its own, with nothing duplicated.
captions.invoice: Snap the supplier's invoice and AI fills everything in. Someone checks it, and it becomes an expense and a stock entry at once.
captions.bi: The owner sees when the motel fills up, which suites earn the most and when a shift closes short, without building a spreadsheet.
captions.tenants: Every motel runs on the same system, but one never sees another's data. The subscription is billed by Pix or boleto, with an invoice.

invoice.photo_note: phone or PDF, many at once
invoice.ai_note: supplier, items, amounts and due date

tenants.shield: Each motel sees only its own
tenants.billing: Isolation enforced by the database itself, not just the app.

dallas_motel.title: Dallas Motel

omdfarm.name: OMDfarm
omdfarm.description: Real-time telemetry for agricultural machinery: operational map, field logs, productivity BI and an external API for third-party integration. I wrote the initial project and defined the architecture — Nx, clean architecture on the server, standalone Angular on the front — plus the Terraform infrastructure. Presented at Agrishow.

eco360.name: Gestão Eco 360
eco360.description: Multi-tenant platform for waste collection fleet management: live tracking, onboard video telemetry and route coverage by district. I built the entire infrastructure and deployment layer from scratch and delivered the highest-risk subsystems — cross-tenant asset sharing, row-level isolation and snap-to-road telemetry.

process.lead: No surprises halfway through: you know what you're getting before we commit.
